Presley Gerber, Son of Cindy Crawford, Dies at 27

Presley Gerber, the 27-year-old son of models Cindy Crawford and Rande Gerber, has died. He was at a rehabilitation facility at the time of his death. The cause of death has not yet been revealed. Gerber had previously spoken about his struggles with mental health and addiction. His mother, Cindy Crawford, is reportedly heartbroken.
